_comment: Our UCP agent profile. Shopify fetches this on every catalog call to see what our agent supports. Two rules learned the hard way: payment_handlers must be present even when empty ('Missing payment handlers' otherwise), and the response must be cacheable - a VS Code dev tunnel injects no-store, which fails with 'Invalid cache control', which is why this is published to the Shopify CDN rather than served through the tunnel. See scripts/publishAgentProfile.mjs.

agent.name: Druids Personal Caddie
agent.description: Shopping assistant for the Druids store: size, pack and outfit recommendations.
